content_blocks.label: clause_1._EXECUTION
content_blocks.text: I, Eleanor M. Bright, execute this Last Will and Testament on the date and year stated above.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_DISPOSAL_OF_ESTATE
content_blocks.text: My entire estate shall be distributed as follows: one-half to my son, James R. Bright, and one-half to my daughter, Elizabeth M. Bright.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._EXECUTOR
content_blocks.text: James R. Bright is appointed as the Executor of this Will and shall perform all duties hereunder.
